services.desc: Book your tickets online today for your next-level paintball experience. Each slot is 3-hours long so bring your friends and get ready to have an exciting time! Price includes a paintball mask, a paintball marker & a bag of paint. We also have additional equipment ( protective vests, extra paint, coverall suits and more pending availability ) if you need, at an additional cost. Please note: ticket prices are for regular sessions only and do not include food, or drink. Prices include tax. Get your game on in an epic 15,000 square foot multi-level arena, weaving your way through real-life hazards and obstacles.
